propositions: Five recovered RP decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) must be evidence-backed before becoming implementation stories to preserve architectural intent and resolve design ambiguities.
RP-02 must establish exact-match retirement recovery atomicity constraints and distinguish them from general multi-file ACID, with ordered tombstone-first validation at the live-operation boundary.

RP-03 must separate adapter physical-retry ownership from core logical operation/postcondition semantics, with a scoped three-consecutive finite-pass fuse and authoritative Jira rate-limit scope boundaries.
RP-04 must confirm explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence, operation-snapshot binding, and removal of Cloud adapter fallbacks without creating new architectural choices.
RP-05 and RP-06 must finalize CLI registry pre-operation routing and code-review effective-applicability enforcement before structural cutover, with explicit behavior deltas named rather than hidden.
